name: Student Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an acceptance letter from an institution registered with the Ministry of Education, plus a course outline and proof of accommodation.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a Ministry of Education-registered institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires evidence of financial support adequate to cover school, living, and medical expenses for the course duration -- no fixed minimum amount is published.
requirements.fix_path: Document sufficient funds or sponsorship for the full course duration.

evidence_required.document: Birth certificate, marriage certificate if applicable, passport bio-data page
Certificate of Character from the police of each country lived in for 6+ months in the past 3 years (adult applicants)
School acceptance letter, course outline, and proof of accommodation
Notarised parental consent for applicants under 18

outcome.duration_length: provisional visa up to 4 months, followed by a final student visa valid up to 3 years

sources.title: Barbados Immigration Department (immigration.gov.bb) -- Student Visa Application Guidelines

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Barbados' initial build. CARICOM nationals under 16 face reduced form requirements per the source page -- not modelled as a separate group here given the thinness of the distinction, but worth a second pass if CARICOM-specific student rules turn out to matter more broadly. work_rights is set to 'none' as a placeholder based on common Commonwealth Caribbean student-visa practice, NOT independently confirmed by the source page fetched in this pass, which does not address employment rights at all -- flagged explicitly rather than silently assumed. family_can_join/family_can_work are omitted rather than guessed, since the source addresses minors travelling with a parent/guardian but not a dependant-sponsorship mechanism for adult students. Application fee: Bds$300, due at submission.
